title: Shipwright stack profile
description: Minimal schema for a stack profile (bundled, user-level or project-level). Deliberately lax: additionalProperties is true everywhere, and only keys whose wrong type would crash or misroute a loader are typed. Keys starting with '_' are comments. 'version' is the profile's own documentation string and is NOT 'schema_version'. shared/scripts/profile_resolver.py enforces this file with a small checker that supports exactly the keywords used here and rejects any other keyword loudly.

name.description: Profile name; must equal the file stem for name lookups.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema the profile was written for. Absent means 1.

port.description: Integer or a placeholder such as "${PORT:-3847}".

dev_server.description: Legacy single-service block; null means no web dev server.
